code_fix_verified.bug_root_cause: Previously seekTime and isMuted state were in useEffect dependency arrays, causing player to be destroyed and recreated whenever these values changed (e.g., when video progressed or user toggled mute)
code_fix_verified.fix_explanation: Using refs allows reading current values inside effects without triggering effect re-runs. The player now only re-initializes when the actual video (youtube_id or video_id) changes.

r2_video_errors.description: Some R2 uploaded videos fail with MediaError (404 or access denied)
r2_video_errors.note: This is a content/storage issue, not a code bug. Videos may have been deleted from R2 storage.
